title: Completion and done
summary: Failure preserves all open QA and in-flight executions for retry or takeover; explicit cancellation aborts live executions and retracts unsettled obligations. Passing evidence and standing plans survive. Removing a member retracts every unsettled run copy of its QA, even one that passed before a later failure, because completion grades each copy's latest attempt. Completed captures retain independent typed review authority. Failed-run retries retain open work and live executions; manual retirements remain. Ordinary run reads omit per-member closure composition. Request --include-member-closure explicitly to diagnose settlement; its blocked flag describes member gates, independently of run-bound QA counts.
